content: Badiꞌa Kota Duduḡa

Eꞌanoꞌo, iniu vaze mazao veꞌoḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, ḡaꞌe ꞌahige rae mene reꞌuma, “Eḡe mazao veꞌoḡa oꞌoꞌa.” Ḡaeꞌa vaze mazao veꞌoḡa rae raꞌetene, aꞌe ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare veꞌoḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe heuḡa, mazaḡa vaze mazao veꞌoḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, ḡae zuni zeḡe teige haḡai veꞌoḡa idane haḡaeꞌohe.
Eme edeḡa, ꞌouge haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ibi hugano kotaziꞌuma.
Ḡaꞌe haḡai veꞌoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazao veꞌoḡa rae raꞌohe, rehano ḡaeꞌa bare zeḡe teige haḡai tiba idane haḡaeꞌohe. Ḡa Badiꞌa kotaonoꞌo feranogaꞌe idaḡa rae zamareꞌehe?

Ga ḡa Badiꞌaꞌa ḡae mazao manoḡa borofe fureneꞌeteꞌe, zu mene ḡarihe fase aduga ḡaneꞌeteꞌe, zu zamaḡa obone tiꞌetaꞌaꞌe sauꞌa rae ovoe ḡianeꞌehe? Badiꞌaꞌa ḡae mazao manoḡa haḡadu ḡaeꞌa haḡai sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihurifine ibitoḡaneꞌetaꞌaꞌe ḡa mene edeḡahe?

Ḡaꞌe teḡaḡo riḡa zu ḡihurihi rae raꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡa oꞌoꞌa. Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌa kota duduḡaniꞌa fureranadu aniꞌa ḡae mazao zamaḡa ḡuginiteꞌe madaḡano ḡaꞌe aduga hidiꞌuma. Eꞌe madaḡa veize ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare ane zama ḡugiꞌa ḡae rana ufeta ragate nuꞌoneꞌohe.
“Vazeꞌa nagini haḡairoteꞌe idunaḡano Badiꞌaꞌa eꞌe naeḡa zeḡe tibatiba baronoziniꞌuma.”

Vaze nuꞌe aduga zamaḡano zamaze obone tiꞌenaꞌa, manoḡa haḡaeꞌohe. Ze Badiꞌaꞌa nize mae ḡihinoga zu niguzoga ebu mene rudauꞌeteꞌe ḡaboneḡa zenoga urateꞌohe. Zeḡe mazao Badiꞌaꞌa ḡabone tuḡutuḡu ziniꞌuma.
Rehano iniu inaheꞌeteꞌe zu ḡoere huga hezahohanadu haḡai veꞌoḡa hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zamaḡa ḡugiꞌano maḡunoziꞌuma.
Haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa aduga zu gigiꞌa ziniꞌuma. Ibite geno Iuda azaḡa, vesuꞌu hena Iuda mene azaḡa mazao ꞌougiꞌuma.
Rehano haḡai manoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa nize mae ḡihiniꞌuma, nize boro rae reꞌuma, zu zama roḡeḡa ziniꞌuma. Ibite geno Iuda azaḡa, vesuꞌu hena Iuda mene azaḡa mazao ꞌougiꞌuma.
Mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌe vaze mazao mene inaheꞌohe.
Mose goro ḡoeꞌa aḡuꞌa azaḡaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌa haḡaine, Badiꞌaꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa idunaḡano mene ruiziꞌuma. U Mose goro ḡoeꞌa edeḡa azaḡaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌa haḡaine, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa idunaḡano kotaziꞌuma.
Mazaḡa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa igi tauḡeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae mene raꞌohe, rehano Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae raꞌohe.

Iuda mene azaḡaniꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe mene meiro. Rehano zeḡe zamaꞌa uratadu Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa haḡaoꞌi rae raꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡaeꞌetene, Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe zeḡe mazao oꞌoꞌa rehano, zamaronezeꞌe zeḡe veize goro ḡoeꞌa raꞌohe.

Ze Mose goro ḡoeꞌano haḡaoꞌi rae raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zeḡe zamao mirihiroteꞌe ihozeꞌohe. Zamaze zuni aꞌe hube rae fureneꞌohe, eꞌanoꞌo mada nuꞌe ze zeḡeꞌa bare zamaradu zeḡeꞌa bare veꞌoḡa rae raꞌohe, ebu mada nuꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare duduḡa rae bireꞌohe.
ꞌUguḡaꞌe, eḡeꞌa haramoziniꞌeteꞌe hariḡa manoḡa idunaḡano, Badiꞌaꞌa Iesu Kerisoonoꞌo vaze niduꞌa kotaziteꞌe madaḡano fureraꞌuma. Eꞌe madaḡano aniꞌe vazeꞌa ꞌuꞌuru zamariroteꞌe kotaniꞌuma.
Iuda Azaḡa ebu Mose Goro Ḡoeꞌa
Iuda vazeḡa, e ḡae moneo ḡaꞌohe. Ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare Iuda vazeḡa rae raꞌohe. Ḡa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌenaꞌa radiuꞌohe zu Badiꞌa niguneꞌohe rae raꞌohe.
Ḡaꞌe raenaꞌa, “Eꞌe Badiꞌa ura edeḡa, zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa ihohadu naginiꞌe haḡai duduḡa huneꞌe edeḡa,” rae raꞌohe.
Ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare ubumaze kuruḡa azaḡa ibitoziꞌohe, zu uzabo zamaḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa agazeꞌohe rae zamare huneꞌohe.
Ebu ḡaꞌe kauriḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa zu tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa rae zamareꞌohe, mazaḡa ḡaꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌanonoꞌo edeḡa huga niduꞌa zu ḡoere huga niduꞌa meiro rae raꞌohe.
Tena, ḡaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa rehano, nougadu ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare mene ihoꞌeꞌohe? Ḡaꞌa, “Ago ḡonotanoꞌi,” rae haramoziniꞌenaꞌa, nougadu ḡaꞌe ḡonotuꞌohe?
“Ubuma ḡezo ago haḡaoꞌi,” rae ziꞌenaꞌa, nougadu ḡaꞌe ubuma ḡezo haḡaeꞌohe? Ḡaꞌa ḡuriro badiꞌaḡa heꞌeheꞌeneꞌenaꞌa, nougadu ḡuriro badiꞌaḡa kuru neḡano ḡonotuꞌohe?
Ḡaꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa niguneꞌohe. Rehano nougadu eꞌe varadeꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa mae mazagaroneꞌohe?
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Zae uꞌano, Iuda mene azaḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa ni rae sausauneꞌohe.”

Ḡaeꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotine, ḡa ahiri rana iḡuri haḡairotaꞌaꞌe huḡeta. Rehano Mose goro ḡoeꞌa varadine, ḡaeꞌa ahiri rana iḡuri haḡairotaꞌaꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa radu ahiri rana iḡuri mene haḡairoteꞌe teigiꞌuma.
Rehano ahiri rana iḡuri mene haḡairoteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotine, Badiꞌaꞌa aniꞌe ahiri rana iḡuri haḡairoteꞌe vazeḡa heuḡa rae zamariꞌuma.

Ahiri rana iḡuri mene haḡairo rehano, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa ḡae mazao veꞌoḡa rae ḡeꞌuma, mazaḡa ḡa Moseꞌa mirihiroteꞌe goroḡa ḡoeꞌa meiro zu ahiri rana iḡuri zuni haḡairo rehano, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa varadeꞌohe.
Enone daꞌo Iuda vazeḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe mene hube hune Iuda vazeḡa. Ebu enone daꞌo ahiri rana iḡuri haḡairotaꞌaꞌe mene hube hune ahiri rana iḡuri haḡairo.

U zamaonoꞌo Iuda vazeḡaꞌe hube hune Iuda vazeḡa. Ebu Moseꞌa mirihiroteꞌe goroḡa ḡoeꞌa idunaḡano ahiri rana iḡuri haḡaeꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene huga, rehano Vine Zaḡoḡa hina zamao iḡuri haḡaeꞌetaꞌaꞌe hube hune. Vaze ꞌuguḡaꞌe vazeꞌa mene niguneꞌohe, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa niguneꞌohe.
